about_short_description.short_description: Quanta provides software companies with real-time financial clarity and empowerment.

product.name: Quanta Platform
product.description: A cloud-based accounting platform and general ledger that synchronizes transactions, reconciles books, automates accounting workflows, and provides current financial reporting for software companies.

product.name: Bookkeeping Services
product.description: Managed bookkeeping delivered through Quanta’s accounting platform, including transaction processing, account reconciliation, financial categorization, and ongoing maintenance of the general ledger.

product.name: Controller Services
product.description: Accounting oversight and operational support that applies review, accounting judgment, exception resolution, and additional structure to a company’s financial records and reporting.

product.name: CFO Support
product.description: Back-office financial support for founders, finance leaders, and fractional CFOs, including current financial reporting, SaaS metrics, and explanations of business performance.
